title: std::set<Key,Compare,Allocator>::~set
summary: A destructor. Destructs the set. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.
html:
~set();

A destructor. Destructs the set. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the set.
